text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Chat-completions p99 spike on /v1/chat/completions > 1200ms (3 events in 5m). Incident INC-2024-0523. Paging @oncall_karen :rotating_light:

oncall_karen: Taking this. I'm on the call, will triage now. Quick context: increased traffic to the Mistral group last 10m.

bob-sre: Noted. p95 stays ~320ms, p99 jumped to ~1.25s across the route. Looks like tail rather than steady shift. Could be autoscaler lag or KV cache miss storm.

alice-dev: I just checked deploys — no recent canary to that service in last 2 hours. No schema changes.

carlos-eng: Observed a small correlating spike in evictions on the worker pool (GPU nodes) ~10:42. Might be GC/OOM churn on inference workers serving mistral-8x.

oncall_karen: Good signal. Plan: 1) quick mitigation (route squelch + temporary fallback) 2) gather traces & open incident channel 3) follow-up alert tuning PR. Who can flip a temporary policy now?

bob-sre: I can flip a squelch for the noisy route to avoid alert fatigue while we mitigate. Propose 10m squelch and set a graceful fallback to redwood-chat-small for that customer-route.

alice-dev: +1. Also suggest enabling KV-cache warmstart for mistral-8x on the affected pool, that should reduce tail. I'll trigger warmstart script.

carlos-eng: I'll confirm worker evictions and check kernel logs. If it's OOM, we may need to increase node memory or push a restart window.

oncall_karen: Doing mitigation steps now: 1) bob, please create a temporary alert override: set route /v1/chat/completions:p99 to 1400ms for 10m and add squelch tag "incident-INC-2024-0523". 2) alice, run KV warmstart. 3) carlos, check evictions.

bob-sre: Done — created override and squelched alerts for 10m. Rule snippet I added to the incidents playbook:

```yaml
# temporary override created by bob-sre
overrides:
  - route: "/v1/chat/completions"
    duration: 10m
    p99_threshold_ms: 1400
    squelch_reason: "incident-INC-2024-0523"
    fallback_model: "redwood-chat-small"
```

oncall_karen: Thanks. That should reduce noise while we investigate. Next: long-term tuning proposal — want to capture here so I can open a ticket post-incident.

diane-prod: For context, a few customers hit elevated latency UX. One support ticket got created but not widely impacting SLA yet. Recommend we do a per-model and per-route thresholding rather than a flat global p99.

oncall_karen: Agreed. Draft proposal (brief):
- Keep global guardrail: p99 > 1500ms triggers immediate pager.
- Per-route baseline: use rolling 24h baseline for p95/p99 and trigger when absolute exceeds baseline * 1.5 AND absolute > 800ms.
- Per-model overrides: heavier models get relaxed absolute thresholds but tighter multiplier checks. Ex: mistral-8x p99 alert at max(1200ms, baseline*1.5); redwood-chat-small p99 at max(800ms, baseline*1.5).
- Add an "eviction/backpressure" signal: if worker evictions rate > 5/min for a pool, suppress multi-pager and page SRE with high priority instead of paging product oncall repeatedly.

bob-sre: I like the heuristic. It reduces noise from known heavier models during load bursts while preserving signal for regressions. We should also add a cooldown window for threshold changes to avoid flip-flopping during flappy workloads.

alice-dev: For implementation: we can add a new AlertConfig that supports fields: per_model_thresholds, multiplier, cooldown_sec, eviction_backoff. I'll draft a config PR.

carlos-eng: Dashboards: Need a compact per-route per-model p95/p99 heatmap and an "eviction vs p99" scatter. I'll add tiles to the alerting dashboard so owners can correlate quickly.

oncall_karen: Good. For the post-incident ticket I will include:
- Timeline (what we did)
- Short-term mitigations (squelch + fallback + warmstart)
- Root-candidate (worker evictions)
- Action items: alert config PR, dashboard tiles, autoscaler tuning, node memory review.

diane-prod: Can we also add a customer impact summary in the ticket? Which customers saw >2x latency? I have the list and will attach.

oncall_karen: Please attach. I'll set the incident severity to Sev3 for now and schedule a 30m postmortem sync tomorrow.

bob-sre: One more concrete alert-tuning snippet suggestion for the repo (this will go in a PR):

```yaml
alerting:
  default_p99_ms: 1000
  guards:
    - name: "global_p99_guard"
      condition: "p99_ms > 1500"
      action: pager
  per_model_overrides:
    mistral-8x:
      p99_ms: 1200
      multiplier: 1.5
    redwood-chat-small:
      p99_ms: 800
      multiplier: 1.5
  cooldown_sec: 900  # 15 minutes between auto-threshold adjustments
  eviction_backoff:
    enabled: true
    threshold_per_min: 5
    action: "sre_page_only"
```

oncall_karen: Perfect. Bob, please open the alerting PR referencing INC-2024-0523 and tag me for review. Alice/Carlos, keep me posted on warmstart and node evictions.

alice-dev: Warmstart done, initial KV hit rates improved from 0.3 to 0.85 for mistral-8x. We'll monitor tail.

carlos-eng: Confirmed two OOM evictions during spike window. Raised a ticket to increase pod memory limit for that pool.

oncall_karen: Great work team. Closing pager for now since noise is squelched and fallback is active. I'll create the follow-up ticket with the proposed alert changes and dashboard request.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-0523 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Notifications sent to incident-channel and postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
